reference: sources/icon_references.png; C's accepted inventory icons are identity references
common: Use case: stylized-concept. Production world-pickup sprite for UNDERCROFT, a forgotten 1993 first-person dungeon crawler. The input image is the accepted 16px INVENTORY ICON reference board: match the requested item's colour, material and identifying shape so floor object and pack icon are clearly the same possession. Paint ONE isolated object on genuine TRANSPARENT background, NO cast shadow, NO ground/floor patch, no scene, no grid/checkerboard. Three-quarter view looking down at an item resting on flagstones; broad painterly gouache/oil clusters, aged practical materials, chunky clear silhouette. The camera is above the floor, not an overhead map. Pale ivory/ash rim from upper-left lamp light, dark slate occlusion edge but not a thick cartoon outline. Restrained Undercroft slate grey, teal, rusty brown, brass/ochre and ivory. Will be reduced to a 64x48 near sprite and 24px-wide far canvas. Big readable shapes, not intricate linework. No person/hand, no extra objects, no letters or UI.

items.knife: RUST KNIFE: short steel knife lying FLAT diagonally from lower-left brown leather grip to upper-right pointed blade. Broad single-edged grey blade with a pale sharp edge, rusty orange stains, simple tiny crossguard, brown grip. Match knife icon. Whole object visible. It is lying down, not standing on its point.
items.shard: GLASS SHARD: a single broad irregular triangular shard of sea-green/aqua glass lying flat at a slight diagonal. Jagged asymmetrical broken silhouette, two broad ivory edge highlights and teal transparent-looking planes, slight dark cloth wrap at one corner so it can be wielded. Match shard icon. No bottle, no sword, no uniform polished crystal.
items.club: IRON CLUB: a short worn wood handle attached to a squat heavy angular iron cudgel head, lying flat diagonally. Match club icon: dull slate-grey lump of iron head at upper-right, brown grip lower-left, ash-grey facets and pale worn rim, no spikes, no axe edge. Handle and head distinct even when tiny.
items.stone: ROUND STONE: one rough naturally irregular river stone sitting on its broad base. Match grey stone icon's material, but make its asymmetrical chipped silhouette UNMISTAKABLY A ROCK. Several large pale ash-grey angular facets and natural fracture across a solid dark slate body, flattened uneven base. NOT hemispherical, NO smooth dome, NO raised rim, NO brim, NO hollow opening, NO dark visor/slit, NO band around it, NO helmet or manufactured object. One side higher than the other, mottled worn edges, simple broad planes.
